results.title: Tax Parcel Layer
results.description: The Tax Parcels Layer is to assist the Assessors in value determinations of Real Property in Rock County, outside of the Cities of Beloit and Janesville. Tax Parcels are defined by Certified Survey Maps, Subdivision Plats, Condominium Plats, Plats of Survey and Deeds recorded in the Register of Deeds Office, using the most current information available. Drawing techniques include COGO and heads up digitizing from Aerial Photography. These data were prepared pursuant to Section 70.09 of Wis. Stats. using public records. Tax Parcels may consist of more than one lot, or may be split into more than one part. This layer is created for taxation and assessment purposes, and should not be used to determine property lines. See the documents of record for actual recorded data. Area and Distance measurements displayed within this layer are for reference purposes only. This layer includes the owner and property information.

results.name: FarmlandPreservationPlanOnline
results.title: FarmlandPreservationPlanOnline
results.description:
Farmland Preservation Plan Draft v 3 as created in support of the Farmland Preservation Plan Update. 

Eligibility was determined using current zoning, future land use and elgibilty under the current farmland preservation plan:

Currrent Zoning

Parcels that are zoned A1 or A2 by the respective towns, unless

  • A separate A1 district, such as A1FP, has previously been certified. Then the alternative district was used along with the A2 parcel.
  • “Ag Exclusive” or “Ag General” zoning has previously been certified. Only Ag Exlusive parcels were included

Future Land Use (Incorporated and Unincorporated)

  • Parcels that have been identified in future land use plans as agriculture or natural resources are assigned eligible.
  • Parcels that have been identified as something other than agriculture or natural resources may be eligible if development is not likely to occur in the next 15 years, or the 15 year horizon. Agriculture islands were identified and removed from eligibility. “Agriculture Islands” are zoned agriculture, not adjacent to eligible parcels and not eligible under the current plan.

Zoning and Future Land Use are not within the jurisdiction of Rock County. As such all data used to determine eligibility including zoning and future land use remain under the purview of their respective municipality.

results.title: Rockwall County Parcel Data
results.description: Date of data: March 2019
results.snippet:
This dataset was acquired from the Rockwall CAD's vendor Harris Govern for distribution in the TNRIS DataHub as part of the annually updated statewide land parcel program.  Visit the website for current details, program progress, and FAQs https://tnris.org/stratmap/land-parcels/

TNRIS compiled existing parcel data and transformed it into a common schema via translation tools for ease of use statewide.  When applicable, some fields were concatenated or calculated.  Null or empty values denote absence of data in the provided request.  Geometry was not edited nor will be in the future by TNRIS.  Please contact the CAD or their vendor for more information that is outside of the scope of this dataset or program.

The enclosed csv/xml file documents data mappings used in the conversion from the source data into the common schema.  This denotes the source field names that were translated into the common schema fields.

Field descriptions are taken from industry standards and supplemented by TNRIS.
results.licenseInfo: TNRIS takes no responsibility for the spatial accuracy, completeness, or currency of the data. The dataset may not be survey grade and should not be utilized as such.
